episode_title: [TEST FIXTURE] Brian Balfour on Product Market Fit and Retention Curves
text:
Welcome to this test fixture episode with Brian Balfour, CEO of Reforge and former VP of Growth at HubSpot.

Brian discusses the four essential fits required for scaling: Market Product Fit, Product Channel Fit, Channel Model Fit, and Model Market Fit. Most founders obsess solely over product-market fit, yet poor channel distribution kills more startups than product defects.

When measuring retention, Brian stresses looking for a flattening cohort retention curve. If your retention curve continues dropping toward zero, you do not have product-market fit, regardless of top-line user growth. A leaky bucket cannot be filled by ramping up marketing spend.

Retention is the foundation of growth. It improves lifetime value, increases word-of-mouth virality, and shortens payback periods on acquisition. Before spending capital on customer acquisition, verify that cohorts stabilize and retain long-term.
